subject: History
notes: Option B core content: the 20th century, international relations since 1919. Depth studies chosen: Germany 1918–45, Russia 1905–41, the USA 1919–41. Content matches the A*–G version (0470). Answers are marked with level-based mark schemes: credit goes to explained, well-supported points and, in 'how far' questions, a balanced argument with a justified judgement.
